author: AbbyLuvsDogs
body:
Age: 13
Timezone: EST
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: No.
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes.
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: No.

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? Yes.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating?  My biggest weakness is probably being stubborn at times. It would probably affect my listening ability towards other players.

What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? Maybe judging situations. I hope it helps the staff team relieve a bit of stress, taking the problem into my hands.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team? I hope I can be a helping hand, not only to other players, but also to the staff team.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Keeping the team in order, not tolerating abuse, and holding meetings to figure out more what's going on.

Do you consider yourself to be a leader? No Why? I don't have any experience as a leader.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? Of course, everyone has different abilities, but for me, it might be having the ability to sense other problems that other staff members can't sense.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Being mature at all times, and helping other players in any way.
Do you believe you have these skills? Yes


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)?  1-5 hours per day.
